hero.subtext: I am a Systems Analyst and Back-End Developer specialized in building highly-available Automations and Services.

about.p1: My name is Atyla (pronounced Ah-tee-la) — I'm primarily a Back-End developer, but I have extensive experience working with Front-End tools and frameworks.
about.p2: I hold a degree in Systems Analysis and Development, and I specialize in building Automations, REST APIs, Services, Third-Party Software Integrations, and Database Management.
about.p3: I'm also skilled in building Dynamic Reports with Power BI, Excel, and more.
about.p4: My English is fluent, and I have a strong affinity for documentation and clean, readable code.

projects.header: Let my <highlight>actions</highlight> speak louder than my words.

list.title: E-Commerce Order Integration
list.desc: Bi-directional order integration pipeline connecting the Plugg.To Marketplace hub to an ERP system. Processes over 900 orders per day with no manual intervention.

list.title: Payment Slip Parser
list.desc: Automation for reading and extracting data from PDF payment slips, converting them into Excel spreadsheets for further analysis and processing.

list.title: Real-Time Inventory Sync
list.desc: Bi-directional inventory sync between the LinkedBy WMS and the Sankhya ERP — keeping counts accurate across all channels in real time.

list.title: Pseudo-Random Password Generator
list.desc: Secure password generation system with configurable options, a history of generated passwords, and a password strength meter.

list.title: Real-Time Delivery Tracking
list.desc: Real-time delivery sync between the Pathfind tracking system and the Sankhya ERP, ensuring delivery statuses are always up to date.

list.title: GitHub Markdown Editor
list.desc: Application for editing Markdown files with GitHub-flavored syntax. Supports basic commands (bold, italic, etc.), images, links, task lists, footnotes, tables, and alerts.

list.title: YouTube Video Download Scripts
list.desc: Batch scripts for bulk downloading YouTube videos, with support for downloading playlists in multiple formats and resolutions.

list.title: Webdriver for Web Application Automation
list.desc: Python library for web application automation, enabling automated testing and process automation using the web browser.
